book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: القطار وصل كلكتا يوم 25، الساعة سبعة الصبح.
sentences.en: The train reached Calcutta on the 25th, at seven in the morning.
And the steamer to Hong Kong left at noon.
Fogg wrote: the two days are gone.
But on time.

sentences.ar: والسير فرانسيس نزل، لأنه رايح لجيشه.
sentences.en: And Sir Francis got off, going to his regiment.

sentences.ar: وودع فوغ، وقال: ما رح أنساك.
sentences.en: And bade Fogg farewell, and said: I will not forget you.
And Fogg said: nor I you.
And nothing showed on his face.

sentences.ar: وعودا قالت: أنا عندي قريب بهونغ كونغ.
sentences.en: And Aouda said: I have a relative in Hong Kong.
A merchant.
My cousin.
He will take me in.
Fogg said: we take you to Hong Kong.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو فرح، لأنه صار يحب عودا زي أخت.
sentences.en: And Passepartout was glad, because he had come to love Aouda like a sister.
And they got off the train, and walked to the harbour.
And at the station door, a policeman stopped them.
He said: Mr. Fogg?
And the servant?
Fogg said: I am he.
The policeman said: come with me.
Fogg said: why?
The policeman said: to the court.
The judge's order.
And Passepartout's face went white.
And thought: the temple!
The priests!

sentences.ar: وفيكس، اللي كان ماشي وراهم من بومباي، وقف بعيد وابتسم.
sentences.en: And Fix, who had followed them from Bombay, stood at a distance and smiled.

sentences.ar: هو اللي جاب الكهنة التلاتة لكلكتا.
sentences.en: He was the one who had brought the three priests to Calcutta.
By train, at his own expense.
And said: now he is delayed a week.
And the warrant arrives.
And Fogg said to the policeman: lead on.
And they went to the court, Aouda with them.
